title: FinVerse: Financial Time-Series Benchmark
abstract: arXiv:2608.03259v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As time-series foundation models have emerged, the need for benchmarks that can evaluate their forecasting ability in meaningful ways has become increasingly important. Existing time-series forecasting benchmarks provide useful standardized comparisons, but they often evaluate heterogeneous series with uniform error-based metrics. Strong performance under such metrics does not necessarily imply that a model's forecasts will support the best real-world decisions across domains. For example, in stock forecasting, correctly predicting whether a price will rise or fall can be more directly relevant to realized returns than minimizing point-wise forecast error alone. To this end, we introduce FinVerse, a finance-domain time-series forecasting benchmark that takes a first step toward more realistic evaluation. translated_abstract: 摘要：随着时间序列基础模型的出现，以有意义的方式评估其预测能力的基准变得越来越重要。现有的时间序列预测基准提供了有用的标准化比较，但它们通常用统一的基于误差的指标来评估异构序列。在此类指标下表现强劲并不一定意味着模型的预测能支持跨领域的最佳现实决策。例如，在股票预测中，正确预测价格是上涨还是下跌可能比仅最小化逐点预测误差更直接地与实现收益相关。为此，我们引入了FinVerse，一个金融领域的时间序列预测基准，朝着更现实的评估迈出了第一步。发布的FinVerse数据工件包含116,897个金融时间序列，共171.1M个观测值，其中60,232个序列被用于基准测试。
tldr: FinVerse是一个金融领域的时间序列预测基准，通过更现实的评估方式（如方向预测）来弥补传统误差指标在真实决策中的不足，包含大量金融时间序列数据。
en_tdlr: FinVerse is a finance-domain time-series forecasting benchmark that emphasizes realistic evaluation (e.g., direction prediction) over traditional error metrics, providing a large-scale dataset of financial time series.
